translations.en.pickthall: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
translations.en.yusufali: When the Sky is cleft asunder;

translations.en.sahih: And when the stars fall, scattering,
And when the seas are erupted
translations.en.pickthall: When the seas are poured forth,
translations.en.yusufali: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;

translations.en.sahih: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
translations.en.yusufali: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-

translations.en.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
translations.en.pickthall: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
translations.en.yusufali: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
translations.id.indonesian: maka tiap-tiap jiwa akan mengetahui apa yang telah dikerjakan dan yang dilalaikannya.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem

translations.en.sahih: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
translations.en.pickthall: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
translations.en.yusufali: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-
translations.id.indonesian: Hai manusia, apakah yang telah memperdayakan kamu (berbuat durhaka) terhadap Tuhanmu Yang Maha Pemurah.

translations.en.sahih: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
translations.en.pickthall: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
translations.en.yusufali: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;
translations.id.indonesian: Yang telah menciptakan kamu lalu menyempurnakan kejadianmu dan menjadikan (susunan tubuh)mu seimbang,

arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
transliteration: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak

translations.en.sahih: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
translations.en.pickthall: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
translations.en.yusufali: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.
translations.id.indonesian: dalam bentuk apa saja yang Dia kehendaki, Dia menyusun tubuhmu.

translations.en.sahih: No! But you deny the Recompense.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
translations.en.yusufali: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!
translations.id.indonesian: Bukan hanya durhaka saja, bahkan kamu mendustakan hari pembalasan.

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! there are above you guardians,
translations.en.yusufali: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-
translations.id.indonesian: Padahal sesungguhnya bagi kamu ada (malaikat-malaikat) yang mengawasi (pekerjaanmu),

translations.en.yusufali: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):
translations.id.indonesian: yang mulia (di sisi Allah) dan mencatat (pekerjaan-pekerjaanmu itu),

translations.en.yusufali: They know (and understand) all that ye do.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka mengetahui apa yang kamu kerjakan.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
translations.en.yusufali: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang banyak berbakti benar-benar berada dalam surga yang penuh kenikmatan,

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
translations.en.yusufali: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya orang-orang yang durhaka benar-benar berada dalam neraka.

translations.en.sahih: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
translations.en.pickthall: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
translations.en.yusufali: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka masuk ke dalamnya pada hari pembalasan.

translations.en.sahih: And never therefrom will they be absent.
translations.en.pickthall: And will not be absent thence.
translations.en.yusufali: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka sekali-kali tidak dapat keluar dari neraka itu.

transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
translations.en.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
translations.id.indonesian: Tahukah kamu apakah hari pembalasan itu?

arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
transliteration: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen

translations.en.sahih: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
translations.en.pickthall: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
translations.en.yusufali: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali lagi, tahukah kamu apakah hari pembalasan itu?

arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
transliteration: Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah

translations.en.sahih: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
translations.en.pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
translations.en.yusufali: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) hari (ketika) seseorang tidak berdaya sedikitpun untuk menolong orang lain. Dan segala urusan pada hari itu dalam kekuasaan Allah.
